item.title: Rallying Cry – June 15, 2026
item.description: From a Brooklyn actress-turned-NASA astrophysicist to a self-learning satellite and London’s city planning win, today’s good news also includes breakthroughs in space music, faster iPhones, and France covering anti-obesity drugs—plus Ukraine’s new steps to support its military.
